text: In 2011, the 11 Division of the Toronto Police Service moved out of their station at 209 Mavety Street and into a larger location at 2054 Davenport Road. Since that time, a local community group, The Junction Commons Project, has worked diligently to try to create a community hub on the site. In 2015, the Four Villages Community Health Centre signed on as a potential anchor tenant for the site. City staff have worked with Four Villages as they awaited funding from the province to take the next steps necessary. Earlier this year, the Four Villages Community Health Centre received a grant from the Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care to begin planning and to develop a business case for how this space can best be redeveloped as a site for Four Villages and the greater community to use to improve access to integrated health and social services.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request City staff to continue to support the Four Villages Community Health Centre as the future anchor tenant of 209 Mavety Street, as they work towards creating a local community healthcare centre.
